en.html:

Ootori Soldier LIf only that car wasn't sitting there like a bloody wall... Captain, with rifles this work is not happening. Bring the Ho-I self-propelled gun and finish it in one—

Ootori Soldier LSir, considering Shishiku sir's temper, standing here getting nowhere will probably give our heads the same gate accommodation!
Ootori Officer B...

Ootori Soldier MHave some respect for your own age, you wrinkled bloody menace—
Ootori Officer BAbe, khopdi sambhal! Don't offer her your bloody head!

大鳥兵士Ｋ「まだです！ 　合図はありません」
大鳥兵士Ｌ「せめてあの車かべさえなければ…… 　隊長、小銃じゃあ埒が明きません。自走砲ホイ を持ってきて一気に、」
大鳥将校Ｂ「とっくにやってるよ。婆さんが館を後ろに 背負ってなければな！ 　流れ弾が壁を破ってお偉いさんに命中でも したら、我々全員打ち首獄門だ」
大鳥兵士Ｌ「それって多分このまま足止め食わされてて も同じっすよ！ 　獅子吼様の御気性を考えると！」
大鳥将校Ｂ「……」

大鳥兵士Ｍ「年甲斐もねぇクソババァがッ――」
大鳥将校Ｂ「馬鹿、うかつに頭出すな！」

en.html:
Ootori Soldier NThe—Dragoons!!
Sayo...One after another you are coming. Historical action drama is going on, is it? And this old woman must be your full heroine...?
SayoBas, quietly and peacefully I wish to spend whatever life is left. Even that much you will not allow? So much work you are extracting from an old body.
Ootori Dragoon AA fine joke. The sharpness of the Nagakura bone-fighting arts appears not to have diminished at all.
Ootori Dragoon ATen years ago, you were throwing me onto the dojo floor again and again. That entire education came back.
Sayo...Oh? And I was wondering why the voice sounded familiar.
SayoOne of my little children you are! So much loving attention I used to give you, no?
Ootori Dragoon A...Yes. Not only me. Half the people here have had their pride broken by your loving attention.
Ootori Dragoon B————
Ootori Dragoon C————
SayoHow very nostalgic. A little class reunion, almost.
SayoCome, let us make up for this long absence with some reminiscences. Once one grows old, you see, these gatherings become the greatest pleasure.
Ootori Dragoon A...A most welcome invitation. But first we must discharge our duties.
SayoArre, leave all that. For exactly such an occasion, drinks and snacks are also there in the car.

大鳥兵士Ｎ「ど――竜騎兵隊ドラグーンズ!!」
さよ「……次から次へと困ったものですねぇ。 　この婆に時代活劇の主人公でも張らせたい のでございましょうか……」
さよ「のどかに静かに余生を過ごすのだけが望み の老体に、あまり無理をさせないでください ませぬかなァ」
大鳥竜騎Ａ「お戯れを。 　永倉流骨法術の冴え、まるで衰えたように 見えませなんだぞ」
大鳥竜騎Ａ「十年前、散々道場の床に叩きつけられた頃 のことを思い出しました」
さよ「……おや。 　どうも声に聞き覚えがあると思えば」
さよ「昔、可愛がって差し上げたお子様・・・ではござ いませんか」
大鳥竜騎Ａ「……ええ。小官だけではありません。 　今ここにいる者の半分は、かつてあなたに 自尊心をへし折られた経験の持ち主ですよ」
大鳥竜騎Ｂ「――――」
大鳥竜騎Ｃ「――――」
さよ「これはこれはお懐かしい。 　ちょっとした同窓会のようではございませ んか」
さよ「久闊を叙し、皆で昔語でもいたしましょう。 　いやはや、人間老いると、こういう集まり が一番の楽しみになるものでございましてな」
大鳥竜騎Ａ「……折角のお申し出なれど。 　先に職責を果たさねばなりませぬゆえ」
さよ「まぁまぁそう言わず。 　こんな場合に備えて、そこの車に酒肴の品 も積んでございます」

SayoNahi, that is not repayment. Almost respectable you have made it sound—that is the trouble. Common sense lagao. You are still ungrateful little bastards, only the wording has improved.
Ootori Dragoon BBeing one against many will hardly concern you... But even a master who has reached the innermost realm cannot reverse certain advantages.
